subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)

(12, 15, 18)

(10, 8, 6)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).**

**Logic:** (1st Number + 3rd Number) / 2 = 2nd Number

Given :

__
 
• (12, 15, 18)

(12+18) / 2 = 15

 
• (10, 8, 6)

(10+6) / 2 = 8

**So,**

 **(15+25) / 2 = 20**

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.

**Alternate Method:**__

Logic : (2nd number - 1st number) = (3rd number - 2nd number)

Given : 

 
• (12, 15, 18)

15 - 12 = 18 - 15

3 = 3 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (10, 8, 6)

8 - 10 = 6 - 8

-2 = -2 (LHS = RHS)

So,

 
• Option - (1) : (15, 20, 25) 

20 - 15 = 25 - 20

**5 = 5 (LHS = RHS)**

 
• Option - (2) : (14, 28, 14) 

28 - 14 = 14 - 28

14 ≠ -14 (LHS ≠ RHS)

 
• Option - (3) : (13, 10, 17)

10 - 13 = 17 - 10

3 ≠ 7 (LHS ≠ RHS)

 
• Option - (4) : (19, 18, 1) 

18 - 19 = 1 - 18

-1 ≠ -17 (LHS ≠ RHS) 

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
